origin: Original deterministic oscillator and filtered-noise synthesis; no sampled audio

focus.enter.purpose: 进入专注，一次短上行提示

focus.exit.purpose: 退出专注，一次短下行提示

suggestedClientPlayback.category: retain existing UI sound category and settings routing
suggestedClientPlayback.volumeStatus: Provisional based on current FocusClient, must balance in actual game
suggestedClientPlayback.note: Do not retain the old 1.35/0.85 pitch change; the files already encode enter/exit contrast.

transitionContract.exit: Once on confirmed active-to-inactive transition; manual release/landing/exhaustion/eligibility loss share this asset
transitionContract.pauseDisconnect: Do not play on pause/teardown; preserve current silent reset intent; pause/resume behavior must be verified during integration
transitionContract.graphicsOff: Sound still follows focus state when visual filter disabled
transitionContract.lowStamina: No extra sound in this delivery
transitionContract.rapidTransitions: If testing reveals overlapping tails, stop or fade previous focus sound only; proposed integration handling, not implemented

resourceProposal.registry: Register custom SoundEvents and subtitles through project conventions/datagen
resourceProposal.soundsJson: sounds-proposal.json is an isolated reference fragment, not a replacement for generated resources

loudness.method: ffmpeg loudnorm input analysis only; no normalization applied
loudness.note: Very short transients: whole-file RMS/true peak are primary; LUFS depends on gating.
